paragraphs.text: Chicken is an obsolete silver-bordered species and current celebration card creature type used for cards which depict a species of domesticated fowl.

Chicken debuted as a creature type in Unglued but was later removed as a type during the Grand Creature Type Update when its only cards were errataed to be Birds instead. However, it was later also included on a celebration card as a type for the non-legal limited Robot Chicken card.
The type was also going to return in the cancelled Unglued 2: The Obligatory Sequel on a planned card called Bantam of the Opera.
